module_summary: Dual-port AXI-Lite RAM: two independently clocked AXI-Lite slave ports each arbitrate read vs write with a last-read toggle and access a shared byte-strobed memory array, with optional output pipeline.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: Shared word memory written with byte strobes and read by both ports.

anchors.name: s_axil_a_wdata
anchors.why: Port A write data stored into mem per strobe byte.

anchors.name: s_axil_a_rdata
anchors.why: Port A read data from rdata register or pipeline register.

anchors.name: s_axil_a_awaddr
anchors.why: Port A write address, shifted to word index into mem.

anchors.name: s_axil_a_araddr
anchors.why: Port A read address, shifted to word index into mem.

anchors.name: last_read_a_reg
anchors.why: Port A read/write alternation priority when both requests eligible.

anchors.name: write_eligible_a
anchors.why: Port A write request ready to proceed given aw/w valid and B channel free.

anchors.name: read_eligible_a
anchors.why: Port A read request eligible when R channel can accept.

anchors.name: mem_wr_en_a
anchors.why: Port A memory write enable.

anchors.name: mem_rd_en_a
anchors.why: Port A memory read enable loading rdata register.

anchors.name: s_axil_a_awvalid
anchors.why: Port A write address valid.

anchors.name: s_axil_a_arvalid
anchors.why: Port A read address valid.

anchors.name: s_axil_a_rvalid
anchors.why: Port A read data valid.

anchors.name: s_axil_a_bvalid
anchors.why: Port A write response valid.

anchors.name: s_axil_a_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Port A registered memory read data.

anchors.name: s_axil_b_wdata
anchors.why: Port B write data stored into mem per strobe byte.

anchors.name: s_axil_b_rdata
anchors.why: Port B read data from rdata register or pipeline register.

anchors.name: s_axil_b_awaddr
anchors.why: Port B write address, shifted to word index into mem.

anchors.name: s_axil_b_araddr
anchors.why: Port B read address, shifted to word index into mem.

anchors.name: last_read_b_reg
anchors.why: Port B read/write alternation priority when both requests eligible.

anchors.name: write_eligible_b
anchors.why: Port B write request eligible.

anchors.name: read_eligible_b
anchors.why: Port B read request eligible.

anchors.name: mem_wr_en_b
anchors.why: Port B memory write enable.

anchors.name: mem_rd_en_b
anchors.why: Port B memory read enable loading rdata register.

anchors.name: s_axil_b_awvalid
anchors.why: Port B write address valid.

anchors.name: s_axil_b_arvalid
anchors.why: Port B read address valid.

anchors.name: s_axil_b_rvalid
anchors.why: Port B read data valid.

anchors.name: s_axil_b_bvalid
anchors.why: Port B write response valid.

anchors.name: s_axil_b_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Port B registered memory read data.

groups.name: Shared memory
groups.description: Dual-ported word array with byte-strobe writes.

groups.name: Port A controller
groups.description: Arbitrates port A reads versus writes and generates AXI-Lite handshakes.

groups.name: Port A read output
groups.description: Port A read data register with optional output pipeline stage.

groups.name: Port B controller
groups.description: Arbitrates port B reads versus writes and generates AXI-Lite handshakes.

groups.name: Port B read output
groups.description: Port B read data register with optional output pipeline stage.
